item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting southern China will moderate gradually tomorrow. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather will improve gradually over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week and it will be hot during the day. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China towards the weekend to early next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches at night.
Temp range: 22 - 26 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
